# m3_config.toml reference

<!-- GENERATED by bin/gen_config_docs.py from the config registry. Do not edit. -->

The file is `m3_config.toml` in the config root (`--config <file>` > `M3_CONFIG_ROOT` > `~/.m3/config`). It carries `schema_version = 1`. When the config root has none, `m3 setup`, `m3 upgrade` and `m3 config import-env` create it from `default-m3_config.toml`, which lists every key below commented at its default. An existing file is never recreated or overwritten.

Precedence for each setting: a command-line flag (`--set KEY=VALUE`), then this file, then the default. m3 reads no setting from the environment, `.env` or `.llm_config.json`: the environment names listed below are not read, and `m3 doctor` and `m3 setup` name any still set so you can delete them. `m3 config show --origin` prints where each value came from; `m3 config set KEY VALUE` and `m3 config unset KEY` change this file. When this file does not exist yet, setup copies values from those older places into it once; `m3 config import-env` does the same on request.

| `read_log_retention_days` | integer | `90` | `M3_AUDIT_READ_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS` | restart to apply; Days the read-access log keeps a row before maintenance prunes it. |

## [crypto]

| Key | Type | Default | Former environment names (not read) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `backend` | string | `DEFAULT` | `M3_CRYPTO_BACKEND` | restart to apply; one of `DEFAULT`, `WOLFSSL`; Crypto backend: DEFAULT or WOLFSSL (forced by crypto.fips_mode / fips_strict). (Today an unknown value acts as DEFAULT; it is now an error.) |
| `fips_mode` | boolean | `false` | `M3_FIPS_MODE` | restart to apply; FIPS 140-3 mode: wolfSSL/wolfCrypt is required and any failure is fatal. |
| `fips_strict` | boolean | `false` | `M3_FIPS_STRICT` | restart to apply; Also require the CMVP-validated wolfCrypt build (implies the wolfSSL backend). |
| `tls_validated` | boolean | `false` | (none) | restart to apply; Under crypto.fips_strict, attest that network TLS (Python's ssl and PostgreSQL's libpq) runs on a FIPS 140-3 validated library, e.g. an OS FIPS OpenSSL provider. m3 cannot verify this itself; without it, strict mode refuses network TLS. See docs/FIPS_MODULE_BOUNDARY.md. |
| `wolfssl_lib` | path | (none) | `M3_WOLFSSL_LIB` | restart to apply; The wolfSSL library file tried first; unset searches the trusted lib dirs. |
| `wolfssl_sha256` | string | (none) | `M3_WOLFSSL_SHA256` | restart to apply; Integrity pin for the wolfSSL library; checked when wolfSSL initialises. |

| `token_overlap` | integer | `2000` | `M3_EMBED_TOKEN_OVERLAP` | restart to apply; Token overlap between chunks. |
| `url` | string | (none) | `M3_EMBED_URL` | restart to apply; Embedding endpoint override; unset uses the configured endpoints. |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string | (none) | `M3_WIKI_DRIFT_MODEL` | restart to apply; Judge model. Default: wiki.synth.model. |
| `timeout_s` | number | `30.0` | `M3_WIKI_DRIFT_TIMEOUT` | restart to apply; Seconds a judge call may take. |
| `url` | string | (none) | `M3_WIKI_DRIFT_URL` | restart to apply; Citation-drift and derivability judge URL. Default: wiki.synth.url. |

## [wiki.synth]

| Key | Type | Default | Former environment names (not read) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string | (none) | `M3_WIKI_SYNTH_MODEL` | restart to apply; Synthesis model; unset uses the server's. |
| `timeout_s` | number | `30.0` | `M3_WIKI_SYNTH_TIMEOUT` | restart to apply; Seconds a synthesis call may take. |
| `url` | string | `http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1/chat/completions` | `M3_WIKI_SYNTH_URL` | restart to apply; Chat-completions URL for wiki synthesis. |

## Secrets

Secrets are never read from this file, or from the environment. Each resolves from the user-only secrets file (`[secrets].file`), then the OS keyring entry that file names (`NAME = { keyring = "service/key" }`, or `system/NAME` when it does not list the name), then the encrypted vault, except a *bootstrap* secret, which never comes from the vault. Store one with `m3 secret set NAME` (add `--keyring` for the OS keyring, or `--stdin` to read the value from a script's standard input); `m3 config import-env` moves the ones set in the older places.

| Name | Former environment names (not read; `import-env` copies them) | Bootstrap | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AGENT_OS_MASTER_KEY` | `AGENT_OS_MASTER_KEY` | yes | Key that decrypts the vault. |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | no | Anthropic API key. |
| `GEMINI_API_KEY` | `GEMINI_API_KEY` | no | Gemini API key. |
| `LM_API_TOKEN` | `LM_API_TOKEN`, `LM_STUDIO_API_KEY` | no | Token for the local LLM endpoint. |
| `M3_AGENT_OS_SALT_HEX` | `M3_AGENT_OS_SALT_HEX` | yes | The vault's device salt. |
| `M3_CDW_PG_URL` | `M3_CDW_PG_URL`, `PG_URL` | no | DSN of the pg_sync data warehouse. |
| `M3_CLOUD_AUTH_TOKEN` | `M3_CLOUD_AUTH_TOKEN` | no | Bearer token for the tier-4 cloud embedder. |
| `M3_EMBED_SERVER_TOKEN` | `M3_EMBED_SERVER_TOKEN` | no | Bearer token for the shared embed server's listener for other machines (`m3 embedder secure`). |
| `M3_EMBED_SERVER_TOKEN_SHA256` | `M3_EMBED_SERVER_TOKEN_SHA256` | no | SHA-256 (hex) of M3_EMBED_SERVER_TOKEN; m3-embed-server checks bearer tokens against it (written by `m3 embedder secure`). |
| `M3_PRIMARY_PG_URL` | `M3_PRIMARY_PG_URL`, `M3_PG_URL` | yes | DSN of a PostgreSQL primary store. |
| `M3_SERVE_TOKEN` | `M3_SERVE_TOKEN` | no | Bearer token `m3 serve` requires. |
| `MCP_PROXY_KEY` | `MCP_PROXY_KEY` | no | Shared token the MCP proxy requires; unset runs it without auth (warned). |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | `OPENAI_API_KEY` | no | OpenAI API key. |
| `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN` | `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN` | no | OpenClaw gateway token. |
| `XAI_API_KEY` | `XAI_API_KEY` | no | xAI API key (the connect_xai_grok profile). |
